content:
# Add S3 Logs Bucket to knr-ops

## Directory Structure

```
infra/
├── s3/
│   └── logs/
│       ├── base/
│       │   ├── kustomization.yaml
│       │   ├── bucket.yaml
│       │   ├── iam-role.yaml
│       │   └── iam-policy.yaml
│       └── overlays/
│           ├── dev/
│           │   ├── kustomization.yaml
│           │   └── .sops.yaml
│           └── prod/
│               ├── kustomization.yaml
│               └── .sops.yaml
└── iam/ (existing)

flux/
└── kustomizations.yaml (update existing or new file)
```

---

## Base Manifests

### `infra/s3/logs/base/kustomization.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization

namespace: aws-controllers-k8s

resources:
  - bucket.yaml
  - iam-role.yaml
  - iam-policy.yaml

commonLabels:
  app: myapp
  component: logs
  managed-by: ack
```

### `infra/s3/logs/base/bucket.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.amazon.com/v1alpha1
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
spec:
  bucket: myapp-logs-base  # Overridden per env
  versioningConfiguration:
    status: Enabled
  serverSideEncryptionConfiguration:
    - rules:
        - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
            sseAlgorithm: AES256
  publicAccessBlockConfiguration:
    blockPublicAcls: true
    blockPublicPolicy: true
    ignorePublicAcls: true
    restrictPublicBuckets: true
  tags:
    - key: Component
      value: application-logs
    - key: ManagedBy
      value: ACK
```

### `infra/s3/logs/base/iam-role.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: iam.aws.amazon.com/v1alpha1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-irsa
spec:
  roleName: myapp-logs-irsa-base  # Overridden per env
  assumeRolePolicyDocument: |
    {
      "Version": "2012-10-17",
      "Statement": [
        {
          "Effect": "Allow",
          "Principal": {
            "Federated": "arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT_ID:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.REGION.amazonaws.com/id/OIDC_PROVIDER_ID"
          },
          "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
          "Condition": {
            "StringEquals": {
              "oidc.eks.REGION.amazonaws.com/id/OIDC_PROVIDER_ID:sub": "system:serviceaccount:default:myapp"
            }
          }
        }
      ]
    }
  description: IRSA role for myapp logs bucket access
  tags:
    - key: ManagedBy
      value: ACK
```

### `infra/s3/logs/base/iam-policy.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: iam.aws.amazon.com/v1alpha1
kind: Policy
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-policy
spec:
  policyName: myapp-logs-policy
  policyDocument: |
    {
      "Version": "2012-10-17",
      "Statement": [
        {
          "Effect": "Allow",
          "Action": [
            "s3:GetObject",
            "s3:PutObject",
            "s3:DeleteObject",
            "s3:ListBucket",
            "s3:GetBucketVersioning"
          ],
          "Resource": [
            "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-*",
            "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-*/*"
          ]
        }
      ]
    }
```

---

## Environment Overlays

### `infra/s3/logs/overlays/dev/kustomization.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization

bases:
  - ../../base

commonLabels:
  environment: dev

patchesJson6902:
  - target:
      group: s3.aws.amazon.com
      kind: Bucket
      name: myapp-logs
    patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/bucket
        value: myapp-logs-dev

  - target:
      group: iam.aws.amazon.com
      kind: Role
      name: myapp-logs-irsa
    patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/roleName
        value: myapp-logs-irsa-dev
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/assumeRolePolicyDocument
        value: ENC[AES256_GCM,data:...,iv:...,tag:...,type:str]
```

**For `assumeRolePolicyDocument` with secrets, encrypt with SOPS:**

```bash
sops --encrypt --aws-kms arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:ACCOUNT_ID:key/KEY_ID \
  infra/s3/logs/overlays/dev/kustomization.yaml
```

### `infra/s3/logs/overlays/prod/kustomization.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization

bases:
  - ../../base

commonLabels:
  environment: prod

patchesJson6902:
  - target:
      group: s3.aws.amazon.com
      kind: Bucket
      name: myapp-logs
    patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/bucket
        value: myapp-logs-prod

  - target:
      group: iam.aws.amazon.com
      kind: Role
      name: myapp-logs-irsa
    patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/roleName
        value: myapp-logs-irsa-prod
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/assumeRolePolicyDocument
        value: ENC[AES256_GCM,data:...,iv:...,tag:...,type:str]
```

---

## Flux Kustomization Configuration

Add to `flux/kustomizations.yaml` or create `flux/logs-kustomization.yaml`:

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: s3-logs-bucket-dev
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 10m
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: knr-ops
    namespace: flux-system
  path: ./infra/s3/logs/overlays/dev
  prune: true
  wait: true
  timeout: 5m
  decryption:
    provider: sops
---
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: s3-logs-bucket-prod
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 10m
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: knr-ops
    namespace: flux-system
  path: ./infra/s3/logs/overlays/prod
  prune: true
  wait: true
  timeout: 5m
  decryption:
    provider: sops
```

---

## SOPS Configuration

Add to root `.sops.yaml`:

```yaml
creation_rule:
  - path_regex: overlays/(dev|prod)/.*\.yaml$
    kms: arn:aws:kms:REGION:ACCOUNT_ID:key/KEY_ID
    aws_profile: default
```

---

## Verification Checklist

- ✓ Bucket name: `myapp-logs-{dev,prod}` per environment
- ✓ Versioning enabled via `versioningConfiguration.status: Enabled`
- ✓ AES256 server-side encryption configured
- ✓ Public access fully blocked via `publicAccessBlockConfiguration`
- ✓ IAM role configured with IRSA trust relationship (federated OIDC)
- ✓ Policy scoped to `myapp-logs-*` (least privilege)
- ✓ Kustomize overlays patch bucket name and role name per environment
- ✓ Flux kustomizations separate for dev/prod (independent reconciliation)
- ✓ SOPS encryption applied to OIDC provider IDs in patches
- ✓ Namespace targets `aws-controllers-k8s` (ACK controller namespace)

---

## Deploy

```bash
# Validate
kustomize build infra/s3/logs/overlays/dev
kustomize build infra/s3/logs/overlays/prod

# Encrypt overlays if using SOPS
sops --encrypt -i infra/s3/logs/overlays/dev/kustomization.yaml
sops --encrypt -i infra/s3/logs/overlays/prod/kustomization.yaml

# Commit and push
git add infra/s3/logs/ flux/kustomizations.yaml
git commit -m "Add myapp-logs S3 bucket with IRSA role (ACK-managed)"
git push origin main

# Flux will reconcile automatically based on interval
# Monitor:
flux logs -k Kustomization -l app=myapp,component=logs --all-namespaces -f
```
